policies.name: Meritocratic Appointment
policies.description: The leader designates their own successor based on demonstrated capability, with an appointed deputy serving as immediate contingency.

policies.name: Democratic Shelter Election
policies.description: Leadership is ratified by shelter consensus. An interim deputy assumes temporary authority until a ballot can be held.

policies.name: Dynastic Lineage & Kinship
policies.description: Authority flows strictly through designated kin or blood-ties, maintaining lineage stability at the expense of popular dispute risk.

policies.name: Elder Council Guidance
policies.description: A senior committee appoints successors and resolves disputes through seasoned deliberation.

policies.name: Trial by Martial Contest
policies.description: Leadership is maintained only by surviving challenges of physical prowess or tactical authority in times of existential threat.
